Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Bulk supply must be executed only after the written approval of the samples. 5. Quality & Material Standards: All textile items must be of premium quality, featuring fast colors and du rable stitching. The fabric must be free from any defects, stains, holes, or uneven edges. 6. Rejection & Replacement of Defective Goods: The buyer reserves the right to reject the delivered goo ds if they do not match the approved sample or specified quality. Any damaged, torn, or defective items fo und during physical inspection must be replaced by the seller at their own cost and risk within 7 days of no tice. 7. Packaging: All items must be securely and properly packed in moisture-proof and dust-proof packaging to prevent any damage or soiling during transit. 8. Delivery Location: The items must be delivered strictly to the designated consignee address at Dargah Committee, Dargah Khwaja Saheb, Ajmer. All freight, transportation, and loading/unloading charges shall b e borne by the seller. 9. Payment Terms: 100% payment will be processed only after the complete and satisfactory delivery, insp ection, and acceptance of the materials by the consignee. .
